description: Source code for the OpenClawChatViewModel class, which manages the state and behavior of a chat UI in a Swift-based application. It handles messaging, session management, model selection, and communication with the backend via a transport layer.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: A view model class that manages the state and logic for a chat UI, including message handling, session management, model selection, and backend communication.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes the view model and loads initial data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the chat state by reloading data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message from the user to the backend.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of sessions from the backend.

methods.name: selectThinkingLevel
methods.description: Selects the thinking level for the session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Selects the model for the session.
